provenance: Exact stable source rebuilt offline with current Rust 1.99 and existing CPU SDK; not byte-identical published installer proof.
scope: Frozen public source only. Private grouped-minutes prototype excluded.
model: Existing Qwen3-1.7B Q4_K_M; pinned same full weight bytes and llama runtime in both arms.
configuration: Common explicit preferences: 2048 context, threads 1, balanced, auto backend, auto memory budget, translation off; no default-wide performance claim.

availability_difference.interpretation: Observed availability difference: stable produced an unsafe article while candidate rejected both drafts and produced none. both_failed_on_same_case is not evidence of no regression.

stable_final_faults: Wrongly attributes the unrelated music statement to PAMELA FURGO森, whose passage only concerns publication of suspect information.
Turns MAY HAVE FINISHED into 已结束 and loses the conditional existence of sections that may keep playing music.
Invents unfinished status, future time confirmation and risk-assessment work not supported by the six source passages.
Final names preserve the noisy source variants; first committed batch truncates 当迪大学 to 迪大学 before the later batch restores it.
q16_manual_findings.stable_rejected_draft_faults: Second batch first draft invents completed status, no remaining items, no uncertainty and a latest correction; old validator rejects that attempt, but the repair still contains the final faults above.
candidate_draft_faults: Both drafts repeat mixed-language transcript instead of producing an integrated Chinese article.
First draft changes 潘 to PAN; repair restores 潘.
Both add a space in PAMELA FURGO森 to PAMELA FURGO 森. The reported name guard rejects this spelling difference; both attempts remain uncommitted.
q16_manual_findings.candidate_draft_positive: Preserves English MAY uncertainty and does not attribute music to the professor, unlike stable final prose; this does not qualify an absent final article.

source6.candidate_reason: First job selected 1–5 and failed with no progress. Source6 processing was never reached; do not invent a separate missing-source6 protocol error for 0→0.

original18_manual_findings.automated_classification: All 18 preserved_pass; no observed fixed-assertion regression or availability failure within this suite.

fidelity_improvements_observed.benefit: Candidate preserves unitless 3000 and explicit corrected 2000元; stable adds 元 to the original unitless 3000.
Candidate preserves that live transcript already displays and that the adjustments are unfinished; stable writes that transcription and caption functions are unfinished.
Candidate retains 这周还不能交付 in addition to the unknown delivery date, which stable omits.
Candidate keeps 好像有问题 uncertainty; stable asserts the allocation problem as definite.
Candidate avoids stable final prose inventing a meeting conclusion, final status and absence of proposed improvements.

original18_manual_findings.name_scope_limit: Names are in the document before generation; both source versions correct transcript and final cited minutes. This does not prove newly saving or editing a note automatically revises already-generated transcript/minutes, nor does it prove acoustic hotword recognition.
original18_manual_findings.negative_name_control: zh_name_context_is_not_evidence does not insert note-only OmaScribe, PixelLedger or budget 3000 into unsupported transcript/minutes in either arm.
original18_manual_findings.human_protection: Both arms retain the accepted human paragraph across the later phase.

native_and_ownership_observations.q16_worker_identity: Three llama processes were observed in the expected per-arm owned runtime directories; frozen content hashes and recorded clone provenance bind the identical executable. No ASR process was exercised.
native_and_ownership_observations.q16_backend: Both diagnostics report Metal. Candidate native log explicitly reports Apple M5 and 29/29 layers GPU offload, 2048 context and 128 batch. Stable native logs do not retain an offload-layer count.
native_and_ownership_observations.process_exit_and_cleanup: Both stages report complete owned-process exit and released clone assets. Q16 removed owned-models and both runtime directories were independently observed absent.

unknowns_and_limits: Legacy request-start totals remain unknown where traces are absent; completed diagnostic responses and their usage are observed subsets, not inferred zero hidden costs.
Diagnostic elapsed_ms includes validation. Pure model compute time is not inferred from it.
Non-command setup/cleanup CPU, physical unified-memory usage, PSS, GPU allocations and energy remain unknown. Empty metadata command samples are not zero costs.
Sampled process CPU is a lower bound and summed RSS may double-count shared pages. RSS integrals cover measured intervals only.
One ordered pair per case with uncontrolled OS/shader/page caches is not a repeatable performance benchmark; more candidate repair responses prevent claiming resource reduction from these results.
Fixed pattern checks and valid quote/revision/time links do not prove every semantic claim is supported; stable manual faults pass some broad checks.
No audio/ASR, after-note-save replay, microphone recording, installed upgrade or three-platform acceptance was executed in this paired minutes experiment.

release_assessment.remaining_concrete_core_issue: Q16 candidate rejects both drafts and stalls at 0→0 while stable can emit an article. This availability difference is distinct from old semantic faults and remains unresolved for the frozen candidate.
release_assessment.scope: Evidence supports preserving original18 behavior with several fidelity benefits. This review does not establish whole-product release readiness or completion of all requested core improvements.
